title: Customer reviews in ads: turn reviews into ads that sell
seoTitle: Customer reviews in ads: a step-by-step guide
description: Use customer reviews in ads the right way. Mine reviews for buying reasons, doubts and exact phrases, follow the fairness rules, then turn themes into ads.
lede: To use customer reviews in ads, mine them for the reasons people bought, the doubts that nearly stopped them and the exact words they used. Then turn the strongest themes into advertising, using the steps, prompts and template in this guide.
